title: Paul J NDE3693 NDE 3693
content: I was in the shower the morning of January 8, 1998 getting ready for work when all of a sudden I felt like a lightning bolt went off in my head. I immediately fell into a coma but since I was in a stand-up shower, I fell in a sitting position against the back wall of the shower. As I was falling (which was in an unconscious state) I must have struck the shower faucet because when my wife found me the water was on cold. That fact obviously caused my blood pressure to lower, thus forming a blood clot in the artery that had ruptured in my brain. I remember my wife yelling at me, it is what brought me around. My head was killing me and she was on the phone to 911. I remember them transporting me to the hospital. The next conscious memory I had was of my body shutting down. I can recall the sense of doom I felt as I could physically feel my energy leaving my body; I was so scared and I don't know how to explain this but I mustered the strength to come to long enough to ask my wife to get me a priest and give me my last rites. I guess she did so, but at this point, I fell back into a coma and at some point I remember standing on the edge of a cliff and in front of me I saw a mist, a floating fog, but for some reason I knew it was bottomless. All I could feel, hear, and see was sadness. It was at that moment of realization that I knew my right hand was raised. I turned my head and looked at my hand and I looked up to see that I was holding the left hand of Jesus. I knew in my heart it was Him. He didn't look at me; he just turned me away from the edge of what I can only call the abyss, and led me away and towards darkness. The next thing I remember is coming to and asking my wife to get me a priest. She told me she had already done so, he had come and given my last rites and that is when I told her that he didn't do a good enough job so she did get me a second priest and I was blessed again. At the time, I thought what I had experienced was just a bad dream, but it was three months later while watching a 'Discovery' program about near death experiences did I realize what I had experienced. I was sitting at home, still convalescing, when this man was interviewed about what he had seen. Word for word he described exactly what I had seen. It was at that moment that I realized I had died and come back. I began crying uncontrollably and put myself into shock. Over time, I have accepted what happened to me as a gift, but to this day, I still question as to why I wasn't allowed to stay. Overall, God wanted me here, too many things occurred after this event and before I was discharged from the hospital to think otherwise. My coma, both from the rupture and induced after surgery lasted four days. When I was awakened on the 12th of January, I was told by my surgeon that the bleeding was so bad in my brain that he couldn't get all the blood out, as a result he told me that I would suffer a stroke within the next ten days. He also said, that while I was conscious I should make arrangements on how I should be taken care of since the stroke may put me in a vegetative state. The stroke came two months later, and was minor enough to not cause me any loss of motor or cognitive abilities. Furthermore, I contracted contagious spinal meningitis while in the hospital. For some unknown reason, which I believe is stated in my medical records, the infection disappeared without explanation and the last two of five spinal taps where completely clear of the infection. I still question why I'm here, I question it constantly but I don't know that I'll ever find the answer.

diagnosis.diagnosis_raw: Ruptured artery in the brain with severe intracranial bleeding; later a minor stroke; contracted contagious spinal meningitis in hospital.
diagnosis.disease_name: Intracranial hemorrhage from ruptured brain artery (with coma); later minor stroke; hospital-acquired contagious spinal meningitis
diagnosis.severity_description: Severe brain bleeding with coma; surgeon warned of likely severe stroke/vegetative state risk; later meningitis
diagnosis.prognosis_given: Surgeon said he couldn't remove all the blood and that patient would suffer a stroke within the next ten days and might be left in a vegetative state; advised making care arrangements.
diagnosis.quality_of_life_impact: Coma (4 days total, including induced coma after surgery); convalescing at home for months
diagnosis.vascular_condition: Ruptured artery in the brain; narrative also mentions a blood clot forming in the artery that had ruptured

treatment.treatments_raw: Hospital transport by 911; surgery for severe brain bleeding; induced coma after surgery; multiple spinal taps for meningitis; two priests administered last rites/blessing.
treatment.surgery_type: Surgery to remove blood from brain after rupture/bleed (surgeon could not get all blood out)
treatment.surgery_outcome: Incomplete evacuation of intracranial blood per surgeon
treatment.alternative_treatments_raw: Requested priest and received last rites; second priest gave blessing again.

remission_outcome.time_to_remission_raw: Infection disappeared while hospitalized; last two of five spinal taps were completely clear
remission_outcome.verification_detail: Patient reports meningitis infection 'disappeared without explanation' and that the last two of five spinal taps were completely clear of infection (states this is in medical records).
remission_outcome.biomarker_trajectory: Spinal taps: 5 total; last 2 were completely clear of infection

agency_examples: Requested a priest for last rites; requested a second priest because first 'didn't do a good enough job'
turner_factors.agency_details: Advocated for desired spiritual care while critically ill.
turner_factors.emotional_release_details: He describes intense fear/doom during bodily shutdown; later cried uncontrollably upon realizing it was an NDE.
turner_factors.spiritual_practices_raw: Requested priest/last rites; interpreted survival as God wanting him here; experience involved Jesus.

existential_shift.identity_shift_description: He reframed the event as a 'gift' and interpreted survival as God's will.
existential_shift.transformation_narrative: Over time, he accepted the experience as a gift but continues to question why he returned.
existential_shift.pivot_point_description: Three months later, watching a Discovery program on NDEs, he recognized his experience, cried uncontrollably, and realized he had died and come back.
existential_shift.transformation_timing: Recognition/processing occurred three months after the acute event, while convalescing.

anomalous_experience.experience_description: During coma, he found himself at the edge of a bottomless mist/abyss, felt profound sadness, saw his right hand raised and realized he was holding the left hand of Jesus, who turned him away and led him into darkness; later he returned to consciousness.
anomalous_experience.experience_timing: During coma following brain artery rupture and surgery (coma lasted four days).

validation.statistical_improbability_notes: Narrative claims spinal meningitis infection 'disappeared without explanation' with last 2 of 5 spinal taps clear; also predicted severe stroke/vegetative state did not occur (stroke was minor, no deficits).
validation.extraction_notes: Meningitis clearance is the main 'anomalous medical' outcome but lacks organism, antibiotic details, and explicit physician statement. Spinal tap is coded as verification, but method list has no 'lumbar_puncture' option; used closest available.

analysis.case_summary: In January 1998, a man suffered a ruptured brain artery with severe intracranial bleeding, underwent surgery, and was comatose for four days. During coma he reports an NDE involving Jesus; later he had a minor stroke without deficits and states hospital-acquired contagious spinal meningitis resolved inexplicably, with the last two of five spinal taps clear.
key_healing_factors: Near-death experience during coma (encounter with Jesus) interpreted as divine intervention
Strong spousal support (wife found him, called 911, arranged priests)
Spiritual care/ritual (last rites; second priest blessing)
Reported unexplained resolution of spinal meningitis based on serial spinal taps
unique_features: NDE narrative with Jesus turning him away from an abyss
Requested last rites twice (second priest) during critical illness
Claims contagious spinal meningitis cleared without explanation on repeat spinal taps
Predicted severe stroke/vegetative outcome did not occur; later stroke was minor with no deficits
analysis.analysis_notes: Primary condition is neurological (intracranial hemorrhage) with a secondary infectious complication (spinal meningitis). Remission/healing is best characterized as anomalous resolution of meningitis and unexpectedly good neurological outcome relative to grim prognosis, but details of antimicrobial treatment are not provided.
